product: iPhone is the demand engine: iPhone revenue 54.252B USD, up 21.7pct y/y in Q3 FY26 (2026-07-30). iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max at 1,199/1,299 USD launched 2026-09-09 to drive the December quarter. Services posted a June-quarter record 30.739B USD and Mac rose 29pct y/y on new M6 hardware (2026-09-22).
demand: Growth is volume-led with mix support: total revenue up 16pct y/y and iPhone up 21.7pct y/y (2026-07-30), helped by Pro and 2TB tier mix priced 1,199 to 2,499+ USD and Greater China up 22.4pct y/y. Apple discloses no explicit price versus volume split (SEC 8-K, 2026-07-30).
pricing_power: The 2026-07-30 print's 50.1pct gross margin leans on roughly 2pct of one-off tariff refunds that do not repeat, while R&D is up 32pct y/y to 11.729B USD and AI capex is rising. Memory and component cost inflation, FX swings, or China price competition could each compress margin (SEC 8-K).
competition: Closest substitutes are Chinese Android OEMs such as Huawei, Xiaomi and BBK brands selling capable AI phones at far lower ASPs, with Huawei HarmonyOS providing ecosystem lock-in. They are not close on premium brand or services margin, but are closing share in Greater China (SEC 8-K, 2026-07-30).
market_strategy: On 2026-06-08 Apple's press release promised Siri AI would be available for developer testing that day and as a beta to users later this year. On 2026-07-30 CEO Tim Cook said Apple was thrilled to introduce the all-new Siri AI at WWDC26, and Apple declared a 0.27 USD quarterly dividend payable 2026-08-13.
bull: Q3 FY26 (2026-07-30) revenue 109.417B USD up 16pct y/y, iPhone up 21.7pct, Greater China up 22.4pct; Siri AI beta shipped 2026-09-14 as promised; iPhone 18 Pro launched 2026-09-09.
bear: 50.1pct gross margin leaned on ~2pct one-off tariff refunds, underlying nearer 48pct; R&D up 32pct y/y; iPad fell; Barclays/Jefferies/Phillip rate Sell; mean target 328.22 sits below 341.07 price.
falsifier: Q4 FY26 gross margin materially below about 48pct excluding tariff refunds, or iPhone revenue growth under 10pct y/y, reported late October 2026.
web_what_changed_30_90d: 30d: iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max debut 2026-09-09; Siri AI shipped 2026-09-14; lines in stores 2026-09-18; Mac mini/Mac Studio M6-M5 2026-09-22 (Apple Newsroom). 90d: Q3 FY26 filed 2026-07-30, revenue 109.417B USD up 16pct y/y, gross margin 50.1pct, diluted EPS 2.02 up 29pct (SEC 8-K EX-99.1).
web_true_now_not_modelled: Q3 FY26 gross margin 50.1pct included about 2pct from one-off tariff refunds, and EPS got 0.11 USD from them, so underlying margin is nearer 48pct (SEC 8-K, 2026-07-30). R&D jumped 32pct y/y to 11.729B USD. Siri AI reached users only 2026-09-14, after that quarter closed.
web_demand_product: iPhone is the demand engine: iPhone revenue 54.252B USD, up 21.7pct y/y in Q3 FY26 (2026-07-30). iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max at 1,199/1,299 USD launched 2026-09-09 to drive the December quarter. Services posted a June-quarter record 30.739B USD and Mac rose 29pct y/y on new M6 hardware (2026-09-22).
web_price_volume_mix: Growth is volume-led with mix support: total revenue up 16pct y/y and iPhone up 21.7pct y/y (2026-07-30), helped by Pro and 2TB tier mix priced 1,199 to 2,499+ USD and Greater China up 22.4pct y/y. Apple discloses no explicit price versus volume split (SEC 8-K, 2026-07-30).
web_bottleneck: Apple's binding constraint is leading-edge silicon and memory capacity for on-device AI, up to 512GB unified memory on Mac Studio (2026-09-22), plus China-centric tariff exposure. It relieves a developer and enterprise bottleneck by running agentic AI locally on Macs, with the M6 Mac mini claiming 4x faster AI than its predecessor (2026-09-22).
web_who_benefits_next: Second-order winners: TSMC on A20 Pro and M5-M6 wafers; DRAM and NAND suppliers, with inventories at 11.092B USD (2026-07-30) and 512GB memory configs (2026-09-22); over 500 carriers gaining eSIM ARPU (2026-09-09); accessory makers; Apple developers monetising Siri AI; and services attach after Apple Music Hall opened (2026-09-21).
web_who_loses: Premium Android flagships from Samsung and Google lose differentiation as Apple ties AI to its hardware; standalone voice and AI-assistant startups get displaced by a free Siri AI; and the physical-SIM supply chain shrinks as Apple expands eSIM-only iPhone 18 Pro models to 12 markets (2026-09-09).
web_margin_collapse_risk: The 2026-07-30 print's 50.1pct gross margin leans on roughly 2pct of one-off tariff refunds that do not repeat, while R&D is up 32pct y/y to 11.729B USD and AI capex is rising. Memory and component cost inflation, FX swings, or China price competition could each compress margin (SEC 8-K).
web_low_cost_substitute: Closest substitutes are Chinese Android OEMs such as Huawei, Xiaomi and BBK brands selling capable AI phones at far lower ASPs, with Huawei HarmonyOS providing ecosystem lock-in. They are not close on premium brand or services margin, but are closing share in Greater China (SEC 8-K, 2026-07-30).
web_ceo_promised: On 2026-06-08 Apple's press release promised Siri AI would be available for developer testing that day and as a beta to users later this year. On 2026-07-30 CEO Tim Cook said Apple was thrilled to introduce the all-new Siri AI at WWDC26, and Apple declared a 0.27 USD quarterly dividend payable 2026-08-13.
web_did_they_deliver: Yes on the Siri AI beta: promised 2026-06-08 and shipped to users 2026-09-14 (Apple Newsroom UPDATE). Hardware landed on schedule, with iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12, Watch Ultra 4 and AirPods 5 in stores 2026-09-18 and Mac mini/Mac Studio 2026-09-22. Q3 FY26 reported record June-quarter revenue and EPS on 2026-07-30.
web_what_would_falsify: Falsifiers: Q4 FY26 gross margin materially below about 48pct excluding tariff refunds, or iPhone revenue growth under 10pct y/y, or no Siri AI engagement or adoption metric disclosed by 2026-12-31, or Apple reversing the eSIM-only expansion announced 2026-09-09. Q4 FY26 results are expected in late October 2026.
